learnings: Tool errors (HTTP 400, timeouts) should trigger automatic retry or fallback to prevent inconclusive verdicts when initial audit succeeded
When a full file review fails but initial audit passed, the system should consider whether the initial audit provides sufficient confidence to override the inconclusive
Binary packages (-bin) with pinned checksums from official upstream sources are low-risk and should be fast-tracked when no executable code is found in PKGBUILD global scope
